title: Reflections in the shade lose the sky; soldiers take the light where they stand
summary: Glossy hulls, glass and wet ground in alleys and under eaves stop mirroring the sky; every soldier takes the light of where he stands; a single wall knocked down relays the probes.
stage: Frozen A/B captures (FL_DEBUG_PROBES_AB=cycle FL_DEBUG_PROBES_FREEZE=<dir> FL_DEBUG_PROBES_FREEZE_AT=8, --fixed-fps 30, --set=light_probes:2). --scenario=alley --seed=3 --focus=1,-34 --zoom=9 --pitch=-32 --cam-yaw=1.57: reflections --mood=rain; bent normal alone the same with FL_DEBUG_PROBES_FREEZE_PART=so; the room's gunner --mood=day; the alley and sun men --focus=-7,-34 --cam-yaw=-1.57 --mood=day. Wall: --scenario=breach --static --seed=3 --mood=day --focus=0,-28 --zoom=11 --pitch=-48 --destroy-near=0,-27,house_wall,5, shots at 4 and 8 s (game, and FL_DEBUG_PROBES_VIEW=1).
rationale: OFF and ON are one frozen instant (Engine.time_scale 0), so men, rain and smoke match; the soldier sheet crops two men from it; the wall pairs two shots of one fixed-fps run.

capture.provenance: Recaptured off-screen from this branch (Forward+, RTX 3090, High preset) with the commands in stage.
capture.comparison: Player sheets: probes off top left, on bottom left, probe term top right, ON minus OFF x4 on mid grey bottom right. Soldiers: off left, on right. Wall: before left, after right, game over probe term.
capture.limits: Measured (linear light, probes off to on): the car under the eaves 0.63 (roof) and 0.66 (windscreen), the bent normal alone a further 0.94 on its roof; the open roofs 0.90. The gunner in the room 0.51 by day; a man in the alley 0.80 (warmer: blue falls most); a man out in the sun 0.96. The wall: the probes are laid again on the frame it goes, but with the roof still on, the room floor stays at the indoor floor of sky (0.09 of the view-4 scale against 0.23 on open ground) before and after; the change is the sun through the gap. The Compatibility renderer compiles and runs both levels without errors.

source_ref: dines/probe-spec-chars: the reflection, soldier and single-wall pass after v2.0.2.
